basic_info.description: This charming duplex presents a unique opportunity for investors or homeowners looking to put their personal touch on a property. Located in a desirable neighborhood just off of 24th Street, this fixer-upper is brimming with potential. Each unit offers spacious layouts, with original hardwood floors, large windows allowing plenty of natural light, and generous room sizes. Both kitchens and bathrooms are in need of updates, providing the perfect canvas for renovation enthusiasts. The building requires updates, including  new fixtures and repairs. The duplex has an oversized 1 car garage that can store 2 cars and an additional 1 bedroom apartment on the ground floor.  Outside, the backyard offers ample space for landscaping or potential outdoor living areas. With a little vision and effort, this duplex can be transformed into a beautiful, income-generating property or a fantastic multi-family home. Don’t miss the chance to make this property your own and unlock its true potential!
